notes: GIF assets are converted to temporary MP4 with ffmpeg before upload.
This media judge is evidence-quality QA; it does not replace backend/browser production gates.

asset.title: Video
asset.purpose: Live Playwright browser proof clip. Judge only visible product evidence: multi-client sync, advisory presence, no-clobber behavior, proposals, job/privacy/wall surfaces, and production honesty.

judge.summary: The video demonstrates a complete end-to-end workflow where NodeAgent processes financial documents to generate a comprehensive DCF/SOTP valuation package for Alphabet Inc. The UI is highly functional, showing real-time file uploads, agent execution traces, and final artifact generation.

featureClarity.evidence: The video clearly shows the core feature: an AI agent collaborating in a workspace to analyze uploaded financial data and produce reports.

workflowCompleteness.evidence: Demonstrates the full sequence from an empty room, uploading multiple source files, initiating the task brief, watching the agent execute, to reviewing the final output files.

visualDesign.evidence: Clean dark-mode interface with structured panels, though some areas like the chat and file list feel slightly crowded.

consistency.evidence: Perfectly aligns with the product's narrative of combining files, spreadsheets, chat, and agent execution traces in one collaborative space.

evidenceQuality.evidence: Authentic, unedited browser capture showing actual execution steps, tool calls, and realistic data processing.

legibility.evidence: The text in the spreadsheet cells and the detailed chat logs is quite small, making it slightly difficult to read at standard preview sizes.

professionalRelevance.evidence: Highly relevant for financial analysts and developers building agentic workflows for complex document synthesis.

productionHonesty.evidence: Honestly displays system limits, such as the lack of preview support for PPTX and DOCX files.

observedEvidence: Uploading of multiple CSV and PDF source files
Agent execution with visible tool-use traces
Generation of a multi-format financial valuation package
Inline PDF preview of the final generated report

defects.observed: The generated PPTX and DOCX files show a 'Preview is not available for this file type' placeholder.
defects.fix: Implement basic document viewers or convert these formats to PDF for inline previewing.

defects.observed: The chat panel text density is very high, which may overwhelm viewers looking at a small README embed.
defects.fix: Slightly increase font size or line height for key status updates in the chat log.

judge.suggestedReadmeCaption: Watch NodeAgent ingest financial statements, execute a complex DCF/SOTP valuation task, and generate a complete package of Excel, PowerPoint, Word, and PDF reports in real time.
